result.title: SpatialPC: Deep Computation with Sublinear Local Credit Propagation
result.summary: On a chain of $N$ states, any local learning rule with bounded communication range needs $Θ(N)$ rounds before the loss can influence the earliest parameters, and this latency is usually attributed to depth. We show that it is a property of the communication geometry rather than of depth. For $N=m^d$ states placed at constant density in $d$ dimensions, a light-cone argument gives an $Ω(N^{1/d})$ lower bound on the number of bounded-range rounds that any local algorithm needs before its gradient estimates can be sign-correct at every parameter. We construct a unit-range, degree-$2d$ directed acyclic graph that contains a Hamiltonian computation of length $N-1$ and in which every state lies within directed distance $d(m-1)=Θ(N^{1/d})$ of the output, matching the lower bound. In the realizable-circuit model, depth and credit depth are therefore independent parameters: represented depth $Θ(N)$ and causal credit latency $Θ(N^{1/d})$ coexist, with a separation of order $N^{1-1/d}$. SpatialPC realizes this separation within predictive coding. Credit is propagated by adjoint prediction dynamics (APD), a local update whose $K$-round state on a settled acyclic graph is the truncated reverse-path sum $a^K=\sum_{k<K}(J^\top)^k b$, with error exactly $(J^\top)^K a^\star$. Graph geometry fixes when credit can first arrive at a state; the Jacobian-weighted path tail fixes how many further rounds accurate credit requires. A sparse two-dimensional Moore compiler retains the $N-1$ backbone with $\tfrac32N-2$ unit-range edges and has measured worst-node reachability $\sqrt N+2$ up to $N=65{,}536$, where a 65,535-edge backbone is reached in 258 local hops. With $T=2\sqrt N$ rounds, SpatialPC keeps finite-round task gradients aligned with settled gradients (cosine $0.93$ on MNIST and $0.97$ on Fashion-MNIST at $N=256$) and reaches $97.6\%$ and $88.1\%$ test accuracy after 20 epochs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究链式状态上局部学习规则的信用传播延迟，论证该延迟由通信几何而非深度决定，并给出 Ω(N^{1/d}) 下界与匹配的稀疏图构造；在预测编码中提出 SpatialPC，用伴随预测动力学（APD）的截断反向路径和实现次线性信用深度，并在 MNIST/Fashion-MNIST 上验证有限轮梯度与收敛梯度的对齐及精度。
AI.relevance_reason: APD 的截断反向路径信用分配与「图几何决定信用到达、Jacobian 尾部决定精度」的分析，可能为长轨迹 latent 推理中的贡献分配与监督、以及深度与信用延迟的权衡提供可供核查的方法线索，但原作未涉及视觉语言任务或 latent 状态生成。
